chemistry-killer-07.title: Mole
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-07.material: A yanayin ma'auni (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; iskar gas 1 mol = 22.4 L), girman gaurayen iskar gas da ya ƙunshi methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) da carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) shi ne 11.2 L kuma taro 16.4 g. Nauyin atom H=1, C=12, O=16 kuma lambar Avogadro ita ce $N_A$. Menene jimillar adadin atom da ke cikin wannan gauraye na iskar gas?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: A yanayin ma'auni (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; iskar gas 1 mol = 22.4 L), girman gaurayen iskar gas da ya ƙunshi methane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) da carbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) shi ne 11.2 L kuma taro 16.4 g. Nauyin atom H=1, C=12, O=16 kuma lambar Avogadro ita ce $N_A$. Menene jimillar adadin atom da ke cikin wannan gauraye na iskar gas?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Mataki na 1: Jimillar mole = 11.2 L ÷ 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol → x + y = 0.5.
Mataki na 2: Taro: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Sanya y = 0.5 − x: 16x + 22 − 44x = 16.4 → 28x = 5.6 → x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Mataki na 3: Adadin atom: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ yana da atom 5 a molecule → 0.2 × 5 = 1.0 mol, $\mathrm{CO_2}$ yana da atom 3 a molecule → 0.3 × 3 = 0.9 mol. Jimilla 1.9 mol na atom = $1.9\,N_A$.
Amsa: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Kuskure: 1.5 ƙima ce ta zaton duka CO2 ne, 2.5 ta zaton duka CH4 ne, 1.7 ƙima ce da aka ƙirga atom 4 na H kawai a CH4)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
